descriptions.w3d_d25h_lamp_update_800c021c: Lamp update: refreshes the light with 0x800c06a0, builds the lamp start from its position and reach along the light direction 0x8043c3b8, calls 0x800b0824 with limit 1000, scales the ramp 0x804b1764/1000 by the lamp power and stores the resulting diffuse, ambient and specular vectors into the light data at +120, +132 and +156.
